verdict.rationale: Rootly documents both public and private status pages for communicating service health to external customers. A public JSON API is served on the status page's custom domain, and the API exposes incident-linked status-page events (POST /v1/incidents/{id}/status-page-events), which ties page updates to incident state. Nothing in the evidence documents subscriber notifications such as email or SMS subscriptions to status updates, and the incident-to-page linkage appears only through an API changelog entry. missing for 10: documented subscriber notifications, explicit docs on custom-domain configuration, docs on automatic incident-to-status-page syncing, independent or hands-on corroboration
